title.zh: 将东萨马省Borongan市镇的东萨马国立综合中学更名为东萨马国立理工学院的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Eastern Samar National Comprehensive High School in the Municipality of Borongan, Eastern Samar, to Eastern Samar National Polytechnic School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Eastern Samar National Comprehensive High School in the Municipality of Borongan, Eastern Samar, to Eastern Samar National Polytechnic School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông toàn diện quốc gia Eastern Samar tại Thị trấn Borongan, Eastern Samar thành Eastern Samar National Polytechnic School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแบบครบวงจรแห่งชาติ Eastern Samar ในเทศบาล Borongan, Eastern Samar เป็น Eastern Samar National Polytechnic School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Komprehensif Nasional Eastern Samar di Kotamadya Borongan, Eastern Samar menjadi Eastern Samar National Polytechnic School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Komprehensif Kebangsaan Eastern Samar di Perbandaran Borongan, Eastern Samar menjadi Eastern Samar National Polytechnic School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_8141_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Eastern Samar National Comprehensive High School in the Municipality of Borongan, Eastern Samar, is hereby changed to Eastern Samar National Polytechnic School.
The Eastern Samar National Polytechnic School shall be under the supervision of the Commission on Higher Education (CHED).
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
